description: Previously reviewed project summaries and explicit EC3 constraints retained while expanding the base-edition catalogue.

tables.name: CatalogDictionaryTable29
tables.title: Entries in the catalog dictionary

entries.name: Type

entries.name: Version

entries.name: Extensions

entries.name: Pages
entries.description: An indirect reference to the root page-tree node.

entries.name: PageLabels
entries.description: Page-label ranges with an entry for the first page.

entries.name: Names

entries.name: Dests

entries.name: ViewerPreferences

entries.name: PageLayout

entries.name: PageMode

entries.name: Outlines

entries.name: Threads

entries.name: OpenAction

entries.name: AA

entries.name: URI

entries.name: AcroForm

entries.name: Metadata

entries.name: StructTreeRoot

entries.name: MarkInfo

entries.name: Lang

entries.name: SpiderInfo

entries.name: OutputIntents

entries.name: PieceInfo

entries.name: OCProperties

entries.name: Perms

entries.name: Legal

entries.name: Requirements

entries.name: Collection

entries.name: NeedsRendering

entries.name: DSS

entries.name: AF
entries.description: Associated file specifications; their relationships are validated by the native mechanism.

entries.name: DPartRoot
entries.description: An indirect reference to the document-parts hierarchy root.

tables.name: FileSpecificationDictionaryTable43

entries.name: Type

entries.name: FS

entries.name: F

entries.name: UF

entries.name: DOS

entries.name: Mac
entries.description: A historical platform-specific file name, deprecated in PDF 2.0.

entries.name: Unix
entries.description: A historical platform-specific file name, deprecated in PDF 2.0.

entries.name: ID
entries.description: Two byte-string identifiers of the referenced file.

entries.name: V
entries.description: Whether the referenced file is volatile.

entries.name: EF
entries.description: Embedded-file stream bindings; required with related-file bindings.

entries.name: RF
entries.description: Related-file arrays matching embedded-file bindings.

entries.name: Desc
entries.description: Description of the file specification.

entries.name: CI
entries.description: An indirect reference to portable-collection item metadata.

entries.name: Thumb

entries.name: EP
entries.description: Encrypted-payload identification; required for encrypted-wrapper payloads.

entries.name: AFRelationship

entries.name: RoleMapNS

tables.name: AssociatedFilesPropertyListTable409a

tables.name: AnnotationDictionaryTable166
tables.title: Entries common to all annotation dictionaries

entries.name: AP
entries.description: (Required except for the stated conditions in PDF 2.0; optional in PDF 1.2 through 1.7) An appearance dictionary. In PDF 2.0 it is required except for Rect[0]==Rect[2] AND Rect[1]==Rect[3], or Subtype Popup, Projection or Link. AP.N defines the normal appearance; state dictionaries require a name AS. An unmatched state retains the processor fallback defined in 12.5.5.
entries.qualifier: Required except for conditions listed below (PDF 2.0); optional in PDF 1.2 through PDF 1.7

tables.name: DPartDictionaryTable409
tables.title: Entries in a DPart dictionary

entries.name: DParts
entries.description: (Shall not be present if Start is present; PDF 2.0) EC3 issue 612: a nonempty flat array of indirect references to immediate descendant DPart dictionaries. Nested arrays are not permitted.
entries.qualifier: Shall not be present if a Start key is present; PDF 2.0

entries.name: Metadata
entries.description: EC3 issue 290 prohibits Metadata in DPart dictionaries. This original table entry is retained for source traceability; the executable DPart constraint rejects a non-null value. Hierarchy XMP belongs on DPartRoot.
entries.qualifier: Optional; PDF 2.0; shall be an indirect reference

tables.name: DeveloperExtensionsDictionaryTable49
tables.title: Entries in a developer extensions dictionary

entries.name: URL
entries.description: Required direct URL string documenting this developer extension. Each extension should receive a unique URL (recommendation, not a mandatory uniqueness constraint).
entries.qualifier: Required; PDF 2.0; shall be a direct object

tables.name: OptionalContentConfigurationDictionaryTable99
tables.title: Entries in an optional content configuration dictionary

entries.name: RBGroups
entries.description: Optional array of radio-button collections. The outer array may be empty to explicitly declare no collections. Every inner array is nonempty and contains indirect optional-content-group references; at most one group per collection is ON, and all may be OFF. Absent values inherit the default configuration as specified by Table 99.

tables.name: FontDescriptorsTable120
tables.title: Entries common to all font descriptors

entries.name: FontWeight
entries.description: Optional integer font weight in the inclusive range 1 to 1000. Values 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800 and 900 are recommended. Normal weight is 400 and bold is 700; interpretation varies between fonts.

entries.name: FontName
entries.description: Required for non-Type3 fonts. The PostScript name agrees with BaseFont in the referring font or CIDFont. For a Type3 font including a Name entry, a present descriptor FontName agrees with that Name.

tables.name: RichMediaContentDictionaryTable341
tables.title: Entries in a RichMediaContent dictionary

entries.name: Configurations
entries.description: Required nonempty array of indirect references to RichMediaConfiguration dictionaries.

tables.name: ThreeDCrossSectionDictionaryTable322
tables.title: Entries in a 3D cross section dictionary

entries.name: PV
entries.description: Optional cutting-plane visibility flag. True makes the cutting plane visible; false hides it. Default: true.

entries.name: IV
entries.description: Optional flag controlling visibility of the intersection between the cutting plane and 3D geometry. True makes it visible; false hides it. Default value: true.

tables.name: RichMediaActivationDictionaryTable335
tables.title: Entries in a RichMediaActivation dictionary

entries.name: Scripts
entries.description: Optional array of indirect file-specification dictionary references describing JavaScript files present in the RichMediaContent Assets name tree. Empty or absent means no script is executed.

entries.name: Configuration
entries.description: Optional indirect reference to a RichMediaConfiguration dictionary present in the Configurations array of the RichMediaContent dictionary specified by this annotation. Defaults to the first configuration in that array.

tables.name: PageTreeNodeTable30
tables.title: Required entries in a page tree node

entries.name: Kids
entries.description: Required nonempty array of indirect page or page-tree-node references. Null entries are forbidden.

entries.name: Count
entries.description: Required integer count of descendant page leaves, at least one.

tables.name: DocMDPTransformParametersDictionaryTable257
tables.title: Entries in the DocMDP transform parameters dictionary

entries.name: P
entries.description: Optional integer permission level: 1 forbids changes; 2 allows form filling, page-template instantiation and signing; 3 additionally allows annotation changes. Default: 2. DSS/document-timestamp maintenance is exempt as specified in the source.

tables.name: StandardLayoutAttributesSpecificToInlineLevelStructureElementsTable380
tables.title: Standard layout attributes specific to inline-level structure elements

entries.name: GlyphOrientationVertical
entries.description: Optional inheritable vertical glyph orientation: /Auto or an integer multiple of 90 degrees from -180 through 360. Default: /Auto. This affects glyph alignment and width as specified in Table 380.

tables.name: TransitionDictionaryTable164
tables.title: Entries in a transition dictionary

entries.name: Di
entries.description: (Optional; Wipe, Glitter, Fly, Cover, Uncover and Push transition styles only) The direction in which the specified transition effect shall moves, expressed in degrees counterclockwise starting from a left-to-right direction. (This differs from the page object’s Rotate entry, which is measured clockwise from the top.) If the value is an integer, it shall be one of: 0 Left to right 90 Bottom to top (Wipe only) 180 Right to left (Wipe only) 270 Top to bottom 315 Top-left to bottom-right (Glitter only) If the value is a name, it shall be None, which is relevant only for the Fly transition when the value of SS is not 1.0. Default value: 0.
entries.qualifier: Optional; Wipe, Glitter, Fly, Cover, Uncover and Push transition styles only

tables.name: ThreeDBackgroundDictionaryTable317
tables.title: Entries in a 3D background dictionary

entries.name: CS
entries.description: Optional background colour-space name, restricted to DeviceRGB. Default value: DeviceRGB.

entries.name: C
entries.description: Optional array of exactly three numbers in the inclusive range 0.0 to 1.0, giving the background colour in DeviceRGB. Default value: [1 1 1] (white).

tables.name: StandardListAttributesTable382
tables.title: Standard list attributes

entries.name: ContinuedList
entries.description: (Optional; not inheritable; PDF 2.0) A flag specifying whether the list is a continuation of a previous list in the structure tree (true), or not (false). Default value: false. If the ContinuedFrom attribute is not present, the continuation is from the preceding list at the same level in the structure hierarchy.

entries.name: ContinuedFrom
entries.description: (Optional; not inheritable; PDF 2.0) The ID (see “Table 355 — Entries in a structure element dictionary") of the list for which this list is a continuation.

tables.name: StandardArtifactAttributesTable385
tables.title: Standard artifact attributes

entries.name: Type
entries.description: (Optional; not inheritable; PDF 2.0) The type of artifact that this attribute describes; if present, shall be one of the names Pagination, Layout, Page or Inline (PDF 2.0). • Pagination artifacts are ancillary page features such as running heads or folios (page numbers) • Layout artifacts are purely cosmetic typographical or design elements such as footnote rules or decorative ornaments • Page artifacts are production aids extraneous to the document itself, such as cut marks and print control patches • Inline artifacts enclose artifact content that has context in the document’s logical structure, typically, artifacts of subtype LineNum or Redaction NOTE Inline artifacts can be used to provide context in the logical structure to any artifact. This is similar to an inline structure element.

entries.name: BBox
entries.description: (Optional; not inheritable; PDF 2.0) An array of four numbers in default user space units giving the coordinates of the left, bottom, right, and top edges, respectively, of the artifact’s bounding box (the rectangle that completely encloses its visible extent).

entries.name: Subtype
entries.description: (Optional; not inheritable; PDF 2.0) The subtype of the artifact. This entry should appear only when the Type entry has a value of Pagination or Inline. Valid values are Header, Footer, Watermark, PageNum (PDF 2.0), Bates (PDF 2.0), LineNum (PDF 2.0) and Redaction (PDF 2.0). Additional values may be specified for this entry, provided they comply with the naming conventions described in Annex E, "Extending PDF".

tables.name: RichMediaAnnotationTable333
tables.title: Additional entries specific to a RichMedia annotation

entries.name: RichMediaContent
entries.description: Required PDF 2.0 content dictionary storing the artwork and its configurations and views. It is unique to each annotation.

entries.name: RichMediaSettings
entries.description: Optional PDF 2.0 settings dictionary describing activation, deactivation and initial artwork state. It is unique to each annotation. If absent, the first configuration is loaded.

tables.name: RichMediaInstanceDictionaryTable343
tables.title: Entries in a RichMediaInstance dictionary

entries.name: Asset
entries.description: Required indirect reference to the instance asset file specification. The asset may also occur in the RichMediaContent Assets name tree; the primary instance asset is not required to have a name-tree entry. Other assets referenced by name must be available in that name tree.

tables.name: EmbeddedFileParameterDictionaryTable45
tables.title: Entries in an embedded file parameter dictionary

entries.name: CheckSum
entries.description: (Optional) A 16-byte string that is the checksum of the bytes of the uncompressed embedded file. The checksum shall be calculated by applying the standard MD5 message-digest algorithm (defined in Internet RFC 1321) to the bytes of the embedded file stream. NOTE This is strictly a checksum, and is not used for security purposes.

tables.name: FreeTextAnnotationTable177
tables.title: Additional entries specific to a free text annotation

entries.name: DA
entries.description: (Required) The default appearance string that shall be used in formatting the text (see 12.7.4.3, "Variable text"). The annotation dictionary’s AP entry, if present, shall take precedence over the DA entry (see “Table 170 — Entries in an appearance dictionary” and 12.5.5, “Appearance streams”).

entries.name: BS
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 1.3) A border style dictionary (see "Table 168 — Entries in a border style dictionary") specifying the line width and dash pattern that shall be used in drawing the annotation’s border.

entries.name: RD
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 1.6) A set of four numbers describing the numerical differences between two rectangles: the Rect entry of the annotation and a rectangle contained within that rectangle. The inner rectangle is where the annotation’s text should be displayed. Any border styles and/or border effects specified by BS and BE entries, respectively, shall be applied to the border of the inner rectangle. The four numbers correspond to the differences in default user space between the left, top, right, and bottom coordinates of Rect and those of the inner rectangle, respectively. Each value shall be greater than or equal to 0. The sum of the top and bottom differences shall be less than the height of Rect, and the sum of the left and right differences shall be less than the width of Rect.

tables.name: InteractiveFormDictionaryTable224
tables.title: Entries in the interactive form dictionary

entries.name: DA
entries.description: (Optional) A document-wide default value for the DA attribute of variable text fields (see 12.7.4.3, "Variable text").

tables.name: FieldsContainingVariableTextTable228
tables.title: Additional entries common to all fields containing variable text

entries.name: DA
entries.description: (Required; inheritable) The default appearance string containing a sequence of valid page-content graphics or text state operators that define such properties as the field’s text size and colour.

tables.name: LinkAnnotationTable176
tables.title: Additional entries specific to a link annotation

entries.name: BS
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 1.3) A border style dictionary (see "Table 168 — Entries in a border style dictionary") specifying the line width and dash pattern that shall be used in drawing the annotation’s border.

tables.name: SquareOrCircleAnnotationTable180
tables.title: Additional entries specific to a square or circle annotation

entries.name: RD
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 1.5) A set of four numbers that shall describe the numerical differences between two rectangles: the Rect entry of the annotation and the actual boundaries of the underlying square or circle. Such a difference may occur in situations where a border effect (described by BE) causes the size of the Rect to increase beyond that of the square or circle. The four numbers shall correspond to the differences in default user space between the left, top, right, and bottom coordinates of Rect and those of the square or circle, respectively. Each value shall be greater than or equal to 0. The sum of the top and bottom differences shall be less than the height of Rect, and the sum of the left and right differences shall be less than the width of Rect.

tables.name: CaretAnnotationTable183
tables.title: Additional entries specific to a caret annotation

entries.name: RD
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 1.5) A set of four numbers that shall describe the numerical differences between two rectangles: the Rect entry of the annotation and the actual boundaries of the underlying caret. Such a difference can occur. When a paragraph symbol specified by Sy is displayed along with the caret. The four numbers shall correspond to the differences in default user space between the left, top, right, and bottom coordinates of Rect and those of the caret, respectively. Each value shall be greater than or equal to 0. The sum of the top and bottom differences shall be less than the height of Rect, and the sum of the left and right differences shall be less than the width of Rect.

tables.name: ThreeDStreamDictionaryTable311
tables.title: Entries in a 3D stream dictionary

entries.name: Resources
entries.description: (Optional; deprecated in PDF 2.0) A name tree that maps name strings to objects that may be used by applications or scripts to modify the default view of the 3D artwork. The names in this name tree shall be text strings so as to be encoded in a way that will be accessible from ECMAScript.

tables.name: StructureElementDictionaryTable355
tables.title: Entries in a structure element dictionary

entries.name: R
entries.description: (Optional; deprecated in PDF 2.0) The current revision number of this structure element (see 14.7.6.3, "Attribute revision numbers"). The value shall be a non-negative integer. Default value: 0.

tables.name: PageObjectTable31
tables.title: Entries in a page object

entries.name: ID
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 1.3; indirect reference preferred; deprecated in PDF 2.0) The digital identifier of the page’s parent Web Capture content set (see 14.10.6, "Object attributes related to web capture").
entries.qualifier: Optional; PDF 1.3; indirect reference preferred; deprecated in PDF 2.0

tables.name: ImageDictionaryTable87
tables.title: Additional entries specific to an image dictionary

entries.name: ID
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 1.3; indirect reference preferred; deprecated in PDF 2.0) The digital identifier of the image’s parent Web Capture content set (see 14.10.6, "Object attributes related to web capture").
entries.qualifier: Optional; PDF 1.3; indirect reference preferred; deprecated in PDF 2.0

tables.name: FieldDictionaryTable226
tables.title: Entries common to all field dictionaries

entries.name: T
entries.description: (Optional) The partial field name (see 12.7.4.2, "Field names").

tables.name: SubmitFormActionTable239
tables.title: Additional entries specific to a submit-form action

entries.name: Flags
entries.description: (Optional) A set of flags specifying various characteristics of the action (see "Table 240 — Flags for submit-form actions"). Default value: 0.

entries.name: CharSet
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 2.0) Supported values include: utf-8, utf-16, Shift-JIS, BigFive, GBK, or UHC.

tables.name: ResetFormActionTable241
tables.title: Additional entries specific to a reset-form action

entries.name: Flags
entries.description: (Optional) A set of flags specifying various characteristics of the action (see "Table 242 — Flag for reset-form actions"). Default value: 0.

tables.name: SignatureDictionaryTable255
tables.title: Entries in a signature dictionary

entries.name: Filter
entries.description: (Required) The name of the preferred signature handler to use when validating this signature. If the Prop_Build entry is not present, it shall be also the name of the signature handler that was used to create the signature. If Prop_Build is present, it may be used to determine the name of the handler that created the signature (which is typically the same as Filter but is not needed to be). A PDF processor may substitute a different handler when verifying the signature, as long as it supports the specified SubFilter format. Example signature handlers are Adobe.PPKLite, Entrust.PPKEF, CICI.SignIt, and VeriSign.PPKVS. The name of the filter (i.e. signature handler) shall be identified in accordance with the rules defined in Annex E, "Extending PDF".

entries.name: SubFilter
entries.description: (Optional) A name that describes the encoding of the signature value and key information in the signature dictionary. A PDF processor may use any handler that supports this format to validate the signature. The following values for public-key cryptographic signatures should be used: adbe.x509.rsa_sha1 (PDF 1.3), adbe.pkcs7.detached (PDF 1.3), adbe.pkcs7.sha1 (PDF 1.4), ETSI.CAdES.detached (PDF 2.0) and ETSI.RFC3161 (PDF 2.0). (PDF 2.0) When the Type of this dictionary is DocTimeStamp, the SubFilter value should be ETSI.RFC3161 and when the Type of this dictionary is Sig (possibly by default) any of the values may be used except ETSI.RFC3161 (see 12.8.3, "Signature interoperability"). Other values may be defined by developers, and when used, shall be prefixed with the registered developer identification. All prefix names shall be registered (see Annex E, "Extending PDF"). The prefix "adbe" and the prefix "ETSI" have been registered by Adobe Systems and ETSI, respectively, and the subfilter names listed above and defined in 12.8.3, "Signature interoperability" and 12.8.5, "Document timestamp (DTS) dictionary" may be used by any developer. The values adbe.x509.rsa_sha1 and adbe.pkcs7.sha1 have been deprecated with PDF 2.0. To support backward compatibility, PDF readers should process these values for this key, but PDF writers shall not use this value for this key.

tables.name: SignatureReferenceDictionaryTable256
tables.title: Entries in a signature reference dictionary

entries.name: DigestMethod
entries.description: (Optional; deprecated in PDF 2.0) A name identifying the digest algorithm when not specified in the certificate. Legacy names are MD5, SHA1, SHA256, SHA384, SHA512 and RIPEMD160. MD5 and SHA1 are deprecated in PDF 2.0. The default for PDF 1.5 through 1.7 is MD5.

tables.name: DocumentSecurityStoreDSSDictionaryTable261
tables.title: Entries in the document security store (DSS) dictionary

entries.name: Type
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 2.0) If present, shall be DSS for a document security store dictionary.

entries.name: VRI
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 2.0) This dictionary contains Signature VRI dictionaries (see 12.8.4.4, "Validation-related information (VRI)"). The key of each entry in this dictionary is the base-16-encoded (uppercase) SHA-1 digest of the signature to which it appliesa and the value is the Signature VRI dictionary which contains the validation-related information for that signature.

entries.name: Certs
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 2.0) An array of indirect reference to streams, each containing one DER-encoded X.509 certificate (see Internet RFC 5280). This array contains certificates that may be used in the validation of any signatures in the document.

entries.name: OCSPs
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 2.0) An array of indirect references to streams, each containing a DER-encoded Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) response (see Internet RFC 6960). This array contains OCSPs that may be used in the validation of the signatures in the document.

entries.name: CRLs
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 2.0) An array of indirect references to streams, each containing a DER-encoded Certificate Revocation List (CRL) (see Internet RFC 5280). This array contains CRLs that may be used in the validation of the signatures in the document.

tables.name: SignatureValidationRelatedInformationVRIDictionaryTable262
tables.title: Entries in the signature validation-related information (VRI) dictionary

entries.name: Type
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 2.0) If present, shall be VRI for a validation-related information dictionary.

entries.name: Cert
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 2.0) An array of (indirect references to) streams, each containing one DER-encoded X.509 certificate (see Internet RFC 5280). This array contains certificates that were used in the validation of this signature.

entries.name: CRL
entries.description: (Required, if a CRL is present; PDF 2.0) An array of indirect references to streams that are all CRLs used to determine the validity of the certificates in the chains related to this signature. Each stream shall reference a CRL that is an entry in the CRLs array in the DSS dictionary.
entries.qualifier: Required, if a CRL is present; PDF 2.0

entries.name: OCSP
entries.description: (Required, if an OCSP is present; PDF 2.0) An array of indirect references to streams that are all OCSPs used to determine the validity of the certificates in the chains related to this signature. Each stream shall reference an OCSP that is an entry in the OCSPs array in the DSS dictionary.
entries.qualifier: Required, if an OCSP is present; PDF 2.0

entries.name: TU
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 2.0) The date/time at which this signature VRI dictionary was created. TU shall be a date string as defined in 7.9.4, "Dates".

entries.name: TS
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 2.0) A stream containing the DER-encoded timestamp (see Internet RFC 3161 as updated by Internet RFC 5816) that contains the date/time at which this signature VRI dictionary was created. NOTE 1 The date/time contained in the timestamp token can be used for audit purposes. NOTE 2 The hash value to be contained in the timestamp token is left undefined. For PKCS #7 signatures the datum that is hashed and included in the messageImprint field of the DER encoded timestamp stored in the TS entry (see Internet RFC 3161 as updated by Internet RFC 5816) is the encryptedDigest field in the signature's PKC S#7 object (as defined in Internet RFC 2315).

tables.name: SignatureFieldSeedValueDictionaryTable237
tables.title: Entries in a signature field seed value dictionary

entries.name: V
entries.description: (Optional) Minimum required seed-value parser capability: 1 recognises PDF 1.5 entries; 2 recognises PDF 1.7 and earlier entries; 3 recognises PDF 2.0 and earlier entries. Ff determines whether this is a required constraint.

entries.name: DigestMethod
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 1.7) An unordered array of acceptable digest algorithm names. Array values are SHA1 (deprecated in PDF 2.0), SHA256, SHA384, SHA512 or RIPEMD160. The default is implementation-specific. It applies to RSA credentials; intrinsic-digest signature algorithms use their algorithm-defined digest.

tables.name: AnnotationDictionaryInAnFDFFileTable254
tables.title: Additional entry for annotation dictionaries in an FDF file

entries.name: Page
entries.description: (Required) The ordinal page number on which this annotation shall appear, where page 0 is the first page.

tables.name: AdditionalCryptFilterDictionaryEntriesForPublicKeySecurityHandlersTable27
tables.title: Additional crypt filter dictionary entries for public-key security handlers

entries.name: Recipients
entries.description: (Required) If the crypt filter is referenced from StmF or StrF in the encryption dictionary, this entry shall be an array of byte strings, where each byte string shall be a binary-encoded CMS object that shall list recipients that have been granted equal access rights to the document. The enveloped data contained in the CMS object shall include both a 20-byte seed value that shall be used to compute the file encryption key (see 7.6.5.3, "Public- key encryption algorithms") followed by 4 bytes of permissions settings (see "Table 24 — Public-key security handler user access permissions") that shall apply to the recipient list. There shall be only one object per unique set of access permissions. If a recipient appears in more than one list, the permissions used shall be those in the first matching list. NOTE (2020) The cross-reference to Table 24 in the above paragraph was corrected. If the crypt filter is referenced from a Crypt filter decode parameter dictionary (see "Table 14 — Optional parameters for Crypt filters"), this entry shall be a byte string that shall be a binary-encoded CMS object that shall contain a list of all recipients who are permitted to access the corresponding encrypted stream. The enveloped data contained in the CMS object shall be a 20-byte seed value that shall be used to create the file encryption key that shall be used by the algorithm in "Algorithm 1: Encryption of data using the RC4 or AES algorithms".

tables.name: CryptFilterDictionaryTable25
tables.title: Entries common to all crypt filter dictionaries

entries.name: Length
entries.description: (Required; deprecated in PDF 2.0) Security handlers may define their own use of the Length entry and should use it to define the bit length of the file encryption key. The bit length of the file encryption key shall be a multiple of 8 in the range of 40 to 256. The standard security handler expresses the Length entry in bytes (e.g., 32 means a length of 256 bits) and public-key security handlers express it as is (e.g., 256 means a length of 256 bits). When CFM is AESV2, the Length key shall have the value of 128 for public-key security handlers, and 16 for the standard security handler. When CFM is AESV3, the Length key shall have a value of 256 for public-key security handlers, and 32 for the standard security handler. NOTE (2020) The Length key was corrected to be required and the descriptive text updated.

tables.name: TextFieldTable232
tables.title: Additional entry specific to a text field

entries.name: MaxLen
entries.description: (Optional; inheritable) An integer greater than or equal to zero specifying the maximum length of the field text, in characters.

tables.title: Entries in the name dictionary
tables.name: NameDictionaryTable32

entries.name: IDS
entries.description: Historical Web Capture identifier name tree; deprecated in PDF 2.0.

entries.name: URLS
entries.description: Historical Web Capture URL name tree; deprecated in PDF 2.0.

tables.title: Entries in a 3D view dictionary
tables.name: ThreeDViewDictionaryTable315

entries.name: NA
